mandate: C430 — test the price-only DISTCOR: distance correlation dCor (Szekely-Rizzo-Bakirov 2007) nonlinear-(in)dependence stat-arb family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (2592 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: perp_close real 5m kline close; log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|; sign=sign(log_return) (+1/-1/0, sign[0]=0); m[t]=mean_i r_i[t] (equal-weight market return). For two causal series X,Y over a fixed intrinsic window W=128: a_ij=|X_i-X_j|, b_ij=|Y_i-Y_j| double-centered A_ij=a_ij-ā_i.-ā_.j+ā_.., B_ij likewise; dCov2=mean(A*B); dVar2_X=mean(A*A), dVar2_Y=mean(B*B); dCor=sqrt(dCov2/sqrt(dVar2_X*dVar2_Y)) in [0,1]; dCor=0 iff X independent Y (captures ALL dependence, linear+nonlinear). Four concepts: dcor_serial=mean over k in {1,2,4} dCor(r[t-k],r[t]); dcor_volserial=mean over k in {1,2,4} dCor(|r[t-k]|,|r[t]|); dcor_market=dCor(r_i[t],m[t]); dcor_signmag=dCor(sign(r[t]),|r[t]|). NaN if t<W or any NaN/non-finite in the trailing window or degenerate window (zero variance) or not finite. Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 8 real+placebo (dcor_serial_dev, dcor_volserial_dev, dcor_market_dev, dcor_signmag_dev) + 4 placebos (phase-randomized surrogates of the real return-derived dCor series, never market data, never fabricated). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs requirements (t<W or NaN in trailing window).

methodology.raw_features: perp_close real 5m kline close from C312 (strictly positive, gap-free); log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|; sign=sign(log_return) (+1/-1/0, sign[0]=0).
methodology.primitives: fixed intrinsic window W=128; distance correlation dCor (Szekely-Rizzo-Bakirov 2007): a_ij=|X_i-X_j|, b_ij=|Y_i-Y_j| double-centered A_ij=a_ij-ā_i.-ā_.j+ā_.., B_ij=b_ij-b̄_i.-b̄_.j+b̄_..; dCov2=mean(A*B); dVar2_X=mean(A*A), dVar2_Y=mean(B*B); dCor=sqrt(dCov2/sqrt(dVar2_X*dVar2_Y)) in [0,1]; =0 iff independent (ALL dependence).
methodology.signals: dcor_serial_dev/dcor_volserial_dev/dcor_market_dev/dcor_signmag_dev plus phase-randomized-surrogate placebos over fixed W=128; score=-(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 2592 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 8 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: phase-randomized surrogate via FFT phase randomization + rank restoration to original marginal of the real return-derived dCor series; deterministic seed recorded; same marginal distribution, destroyed temporal alignment; never market data, never fabricated.
methodology.distcor_vectorization_note: exact vectorized rolling form: dCov2=Q/n^2-(2/n)sum(ai*bi)+abar*bbar with ai,bi the per-row means of the |x_i-x_j|,|y_i-y_j| distance matrices and Q=sum_ij|x_i-x_j||y_i-y_j|; dVar2 uses sum_ij(x_i-x_j)^2=2n*sum(x^2)-2*(sum x)^2. Validated against a naive O(W^2) double-centered reference with maxdiff < 1e-12 in tests.
